item.description: Artificial intelligence valuations are climbing fast, and the demand behind them is rising just as quickly. item.title: Jeff Bezos-Backed Blue Origin Halts New Shepard Flights For Two Years, Shifts Focus To Lunar Program
item.description: Amazon.com (NASDAQ:AMZN) CEO Jeff Bezos–backed Blue Origin announced on Friday that it will pause fully reusable New Shepard suborbital flights for at least two years to accelerate development of lunar landing capabilities, supporting the nation’s moon goals.
